You arrive in a kitchen. A typical one. I guess you better just go and list everything you see here.

You can see a fridge. Classic TextWorld. You see an oven. You bend down to tie your shoe. When you stand up, you notice a table! The table is massive. On the table you make out a cookbook. Classic TextWorld. You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a counter. The counter is vast. feedback:

---------
Gather all following ingredients and follow the directions to prepare this tasty meal.

block of cheese

  yellow potato

  roast the block of cheese
  dice the red onion
  roast the red onion
  slice the yellow potato
  fry the yellow potato
  prepare meal
